question: To what culminating divine form should the practitioner extend clear meditative vision?
premises: The preceding verses prescribe meditation on Śambhu together with Umā as Someśvara.
The concluding instruction directs an intensified act of beholding.
The specified limit of this beholding is Giriśa, the lord of the mountain.
inference: The meditation culminates in a clear, intensified visualization that extends up to Giriśa.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic force of anta within the fused form is contextually inferred as indicating extent or culmination.
plain_english: Behold clearly all the way up to Giriśa.
